Question: Which of these is correct, "I will graduate from college on May third, 2026, at the point which I will be twenty-three" or "I will graduate from college on May third, 2026, during which I will be twenty-three"?
Answer: This is how to write it: “I will be 23 when I graduate from college on May 3, 2026.” It states how old you will be when you graduate instead of writing the date and then saying something like “at which point I will be 23,” because that makes it sound like you are turning 23 on the day you graduate.
